style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 3 3ft+4ft+5ft Pre-Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a winter scene home with 3 pre-lit artificial Christmas trees. Downswept fir shapes with snow-covered PVC tips create a forest look. Battery-powered LED lights feature 8 modes, including steady glow and twinkle. Slim pencil designs, fire-retardant tips and IP44 battery boxes fit apartments and porches. A set of 3 Christmas trees in different sizes creates a coordinated and layered holiday display. Downswept fir design with snow-flocked PVC tips recreates the look of winter forest tips. A slim pencil-tree shape with compact bases is suitable for apartments, dorms, bedrooms and small spaces. Battery-powered LED lights provide flexible placement without needing a nearby outlet. Each pre-lit Christmas tree requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) for convenient seasonal decorating. Built-in control button offers 8 lighting modes, including steady on, twinkle, fading, chasing and combination effects. PVC tips and flocking provide added safety for holiday use. IP44-rated battery boxes offer splash and dust protection for indoor and covered outdoor displays. Three tree sizes (F38 x 90H cm, F43 x 120H cm, F48 x 150H cm) provide versatile decorating combinations. Colour: Green. Light Colour: Multi-colour (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green). Material: PVC, Steel. Tree Sizes: Small: F38 x 90H cm. Medium: F43 x 120H cm. Large: F48 x 150H cm. Base Size: F25 x 12H cm (Large Tree). Tip Count: 275 (Large Tree). LED Light Count: 150 (Large Tree). Power Supply: Battery Powered. Battery Requirement: 3 x AA Batteries per Tree (Not Included). Item Label: 83C-316V00GN. Shaping Note: Approx. 30-45 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness. Dimensions(mm): Height: 1500 Width: 480 Depth: 480.
